entries.description: List of encrypted filesystem entries to manage.

target.description: Logical name (target) for this encrypted volume; used as the mapper device name (e.g., `crypt1`).

dev.description: Physical block device or partition (e.g., `/dev/sdb1`) to encrypt/mount.

crypto.description: Cipher mode specification for the encryption (e.g., `aes-xts-plain64`, `cast5-cbc-plain64`).

keyfile.description: Path to a file containing the encryption key (or key derivation hint). If empty, key is entered interactively or via `keyformat=passphrase`.

keyformat.description: Format of the key: one of `passphrase`, `rawkey`, `lvm`, or `none`. `passphrase` prompts interactively; `rawkey` expects a binary key file; `lvm` uses LVM key management; `none` disables key handling (for detached header).

uuid.description: UUID of the encrypted LUKS volume (for reliable device identification).

fstype.description: Filesystem type used inside the encrypted container (e.g., `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`).

mountpoint.description: Mount point where the decrypted filesystem will be mounted (e.g., `/home/user/private`).

allow_auto.description: Whether this volume can be auto-mounted at boot or via `cryptmount --all`. Set `true` to enable `allow=auto`.
